skidbuffer.summary: Valid/ready skid buffer: a one-entry side register (r_data/r_valid) captures input when output stalls, with optional registered output stage.

blocks.name: skid_register
blocks.description: One-entry overflow buffer capturing input while downstream stalls.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_valid
anchors.why: Skid-full flag; set when input accepted while output stalled, deasserts o_ready, selects r_data to output.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_data
anchors.why: One-entry skid register holding input data while downstream is stalled.

anchors.name: w_data
anchors.why: Debug/formal view of skid register contents r_data.

blocks.name: output_stage
blocks.description: Registered output valid/data, muxing skid data or fresh input.

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Downstream valid, registered from i_valid or skid-full flag.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Output payload register, chooses r_data when skid full else i_data.

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; clears skid flag and advances output register.

anchors.name: i_valid
anchors.why: Upstream valid; with o_ready accepts data into skid or output register.

anchors.name: o_ready
anchors.why: Upstream ready, inverse of skid-full flag r_valid.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Incoming payload loaded into r_data or directly into o_data.

addrdecode.summary: Combinational slave address decoder: masked compares of the address against per-slave base/mask parameters produce a one-hot select (plus no-slave error bit), optionally registered with valid/stall handshake.

blocks.name: Address compare
blocks.description: Masked address match per slave, valid-qualified, with none-selected error bit.

anchors.name: i_addr
anchors.why: Incoming request address compared against every slave address/mask.

anchors.name: prerequest
anchors.why: Per-slave address match vector from masked address compare and access permission.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Valid-qualified one-hot slave request including no-slave error bit.

anchors.name: GENERATE_NONSEL_SLAVE.r_none_sel
anchors.why: Flags valid request matching no slave; becomes bus-error decode bit.

blocks.name: Output stage
blocks.description: Optional register stage for decode, address, data with valid/stall handshake.

anchors.name: o_decode
anchors.why: One-hot slave select output steering downstream crossbar.

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Output request valid, registered when not stalled.

anchors.name: o_stall
anchors.why: Backpressure to upstream when output valid and downstream stalled.

anchors.name: o_addr
anchors.why: Registered address forwarded with the decoded select.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Registered request payload forwarded with decode.

anchors.name: i_valid
anchors.why: Incoming request valid; qualifies per-slave requests and output valid.

anchors.name: i_stall
anchors.why: Downstream stall holding registered outputs.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Incoming request payload passed through to output.

sfifo.summary: Synchronous FIFO: memory array addressed by wrapping write/read pointers, fill counter derives full/empty, registered read with write-through bypass path.

blocks.name: Write port
blocks.description: Qualifies writes against full, advances write pointer.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; qualified by !o_full into w_wr, also arms bypass.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem or bypass register.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full backpressure to writer, blocks writes.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Accepted write enable: mem write, wr_addr and fill increment.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer incremented on accepted write, addresses mem.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wr_addr, read at rd_next.

blocks.name: Read port with bypass
blocks.description: Registered prefetch read plus write-through bypass mux driving o_data.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request/consumer accept; qualified by !o_empty into w_rd.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Read data muxed from bypass_data or rd_data.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication to reader, blocks reads.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag; gates bypass capture and o_empty.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Accepted read enable: rd_addr increment, rd_data load.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer incremented on accepted read; base for rd_next.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.bypass_valid
anchors.why: Selects bypass_data over rd_data for o_data.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.bypass_data
anchors.why: Latches incoming write data for write-through when nearly empty.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.rd_data
anchors.why: Registered memory read of next entry.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.rd_next
anchors.why: Next read index rd_addr+1 for prefetch read.

blocks.name: Occupancy tracking
blocks.description: Fill counter producing full flag and empty updates.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count; MSB gives full, used for empty and bypass decisions.

axidouble.summary: AXI4 full slave bridging to NS simplified single-beat slaves: skid-buffered write/read burst trackers step addresses, decode slave selects, and return responses through backpressure FIFOs with exclusive-access tracking.

blocks.name: Write address skid and capture
blocks.description: AW skid buffer, captured burst parameters and next write address generator.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write address request into the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW skid buffer ready back to upstream master.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Upstream write burst start address, buffered then decoded to a slave.

anchors.name: awskid_valid
anchors.why: AW skid buffer output valid starting a new write burst.

anchors.name: write_awskidready
anchors.why: Accepts next AW request at burst end when B FIFO not full.

anchors.name: write_addr
anchors.why: Current write beat address, loaded from AW and stepped by axi_addr each beat.

blocks.name: Write burst control
blocks.description: Tracks write beats, drives WREADY and per-slave AWVALID/WVALID.

anchors.name: write_request
anchors.why: Write burst active; drives WREADY and gates M_AXI_AWVALID until WLAST.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid; directly gates downstream M_AXI_AWVALID per beat.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready, equal to write_request burst-active flag.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data passed straight through to the shared M_AXI_WDATA.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave write strobe from wdecode, gated by WVALID and lock.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Shared downstream write address driven from write_addr.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Shared downstream write data, copy of S_AXI_WDATA.

blocks.name: Write slave decode
blocks.description: Address decoder producing one-hot write slave select and index.

anchors.name: wdecode
anchors.why: One-hot write slave select (plus no-slave bit) held for the whole burst.

anchors.name: last_wdecode
anchors.why: Latches decoder output for remaining burst beats.

anchors.name: write_bindex
anchors.why: Registered slave index selecting which M_AXI_BRESP to check.

blocks.name: Write response path
blocks.description: Accumulates burst response and queues it in B FIFO with occupancy guard.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when the B FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code popped from the B response FIFO.

anchors.name: write_resp
anchors.why: Sticky accumulated burst write response (DECERR/SLVERR/EXOKAY) pushed into B FIFO.

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Outstanding write burst count guarding B FIFO overflow.

anchors.name: bfull
anchors.why: Write pseudo-FIFO full; blocks accepting new AW requests.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave write responses indexed by write_bindex into write_resp.

blocks.name: Read burst control
blocks.description: Captures AR burst, steps address, counts beats and issues per-slave reads.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read burst request captured into ar* registers.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready when no burst remains and read FIFO not full.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Upstream read burst start address.

anchors.name: araddr
anchors.why: Current read beat address, captured from AR and stepped per issued read.

anchors.name: rlen
anchors.why: Remaining read beats; gates ARREADY and ends arvalid.

anchors.name: arvalid
anchors.why: Read burst in progress; qualifies read_rvalid pipeline start.

anchors.name: issue_read
anchors.why: Issues a downstream read beat whenever the read FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave read strobe from rdecode when issue_read.

blocks.name: Read slave decode
blocks.description: Decodes read address to slave select and index for return mux.

anchors.name: rdecode
anchors.why: One-hot read slave select driving M_AXI_ARVALID and read index.

anchors.name: last_rdecode
anchors.why: Holds read decoder output while decoder is not valid.

anchors.name: last_read_index
anchors.why: Selects which slave's RDATA/RRESP is captured on return.

blocks.name: Read return path
blocks.description: Muxes slave read data/response and queues it in read FIFO with occupancy guard.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid when the read return FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned upstream from the read return FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated per-slave read data, muxed by last_read_index.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave read responses used to form read_resp.

anchors.name: read_rdata
anchors.why: Registered selected slave read data pushed into read FIFO.

anchors.name: read_resp
anchors.why: Registered read response (DECERR/SLVERR/EXOKAY/OKAY).

anchors.name: read_rvalid
anchors.why: Implied slave RVALID one cycle after an issued read.

anchors.name: read_result
anchors.why: Writes the read result into the return FIFO.

anchors.name: read_rvlast
anchors.why: Locally generated RLAST for the beat when rlen reaches zero.

anchors.name: read_full
anchors.why: Read pseudo-FIFO full; blocks issue_read and ARREADY.

anchors.name: read_count
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats count guarding read FIFO overflow.

blocks.name: Exclusive access monitor
blocks.description: Tracks exclusive read reservation and validates exclusive writes.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.r_lock_valid
anchors.why: Exclusive read reservation valid, cleared by overlapping writes.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.r_locked_burst
anchors.why: Exclusive write matches reservation; allows locked write and EXOKAY.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.lock_addr
anchors.why: Reserved exclusive-access address compared against writes.

anchors.name: locked_write
anchors.why: Current write burst is exclusive; blocks downstream writes without reservation.

anchors.name: read_rvlock
anchors.why: Read beat is exclusive with valid lock; selects EXOKAY response.
